name: Endries Solar And Electric
old_description: Endries Solar & Electric is a leading provider of solar products and services. We call the Sheboygan area our home, with our installation territory covering north of Green Bay, the Fox Valley, around Madison and as far south as the Wisconsin/Illinois border.
about:
Based in Oostburg, Wisconsin, Endries Solar & Electric was established by Russel Endries, a NABCEP-certified master electrician who installed his first solar system in 2008. The company serves an installation territory that stretches from north of Green Bay through the Fox Valley and Madison area to the Wisconsin-Illinois border.

The firm provides full-service solar electrical products and services, specializing in residential and commercial photovoltaic installations. Its licensed and insured employees handle every step in-house — system design, permitting, installation, commissioning, inspection, and ongoing maintenance — without using subcontractors. To date, the team has installed more than 1,000 PV systems designed by owner Russel Endries.

Endries Solar & Electric works with homeowners and businesses across northern and southeastern Wisconsin. Residential customers receive customized rooftop or ground-mount arrays, while commercial clients range from small businesses to larger facilities seeking to reduce electrical costs and carbon footprints. The company also assists customers with tax credits, incentives, and utility interconnection paperwork.

The company says its differentiators include NABCEP accreditation, membership on Wisconsin's Focus on Energy Trade Ally list, and a commitment to using only its own trained installers. Russel Endries' 20-plus years of electrical experience and the team's combined 100-plus years in the trade are cited as the foundation for code-compliant, production-maximizing installations.
